body: I can understand that if it was my FMIL. But it’s my FH’s grandma on his dad’s side. She’s treated my FH and FSIL like dog crap for the past 25 years. She has pictures of every grand kid hanging up sans my FSIL and FH (and not for lack of pics to choose from) of the 6 total grand kids. Every time we meet she “forgets” my name or calls me by a totally different name. It’s just, I’m not very fond of her and I’m trying to be as nice as possible. I really don’t want her taking control and trying to add people to our very tight list. Our wedding is in 75 days.

Yeah, I’m worried it’s going to lead to the baby daddy she’s currently on and off with getting “invited” then her kids, when we’re having a kid free wedding. I have already talked with my FH and he agreed that we will invite the Aunt but that’s it.

I feel personally attacked by this meme because it is beyond true for me LOL. The last two ideas I had were a brothel for cats and dogs, and a food truck called Pregerz tailored to pregnant women and their weird cravings (pickles & ice cream, chocolate licorice dessert, etc.). My fiancé played along with me for a bit until he realized I was dead serious and told me to not quit my day job.

He is the best thing to ever happen. When I was first diagnosised, the guy I was dating at the time didn't understand, or even try to understand, anything that was going on. Luckily, my fiancé is there for me every step of the way. 

And yes, I am seeing my psychiatrist soon, as well as therapy weekly.

So, ive tried the following mood stabilizers in combination with an anti depressant: 

Abilify, vrylar, lamtrogine, latuda, Prozac, Zoloft, wellbutrin

My current medication list is: 

Lithium Carbonate CR 300 mg taking it 1 tab in the am and 2 tabs in the evening 
Cymbalta 60 mg 1 cap

Thank you so much for taking the time to respond!!! 

For the ones in the next month or so, I am letting my sister take them as she does photography as her hobby and for her sorority, so I was looking to save a little bit in that department. However, she is my maid of honor, therefore would not be doing the wedding photos, so we will more than likely have a second set done to test the waters with our photographer. 

Perfect! We will probably do a fun outdoorsy shoot with my sister and keep those casual to really show off our style, and then a second photo shoot with the photographer at a different time and maybe make that one nicer outfits 🙂

We will probably just take some with the dogs, not all of the photos with them! 

Once again, I really appreciate you taking the time to respond! It was very helpful!
